reviewHistory.summary: T758 satisfies its four acceptance items and the complete current ECON-18, ECON-38 and ARCH-9 contracts at base fd56f083210f3dc89d70754753c45bafa561d167. Reviewed pinned commit d8f9498d5e604c5ba56253840bfcb5d89f75887f and its complete diff. The season horizon subtracts annual minus cumulative half-even rounded paid loan installments, matching the telescoping roundShare payment schedule. The 365-day horizon itemizes one full installment for a continuing loan and only the current unpaid installment in its final term, removing the loan from operating costs to avoid double counting. Both low/high cash bounds reconcile with their labelled signed rows. No-loan and expired-term behavior, source-world immutability, existing rates/terms/payments/ledger and staff-policy thresholds are preserved. The actual signingVerdict regression demonstrates the intentional affordability change. Integration-test edits are limited to the added loan label and excluding its separately itemized amount from operating-row expectations. Reused exact-submission evidence: 31 new cases (19 failing before the correction), 36 focused cases including unchanged loan settlement coverage, 128 files/1173 affected unit cases, typecheck/lint/format/i18n/build pass. An additional read-only numeric diagnostic checked all 47 played-round horizons for 8 installments, including half-even ties and an integer beyond Number precision; all 376 telescoping comparisons matched. Upstream next still equals the pinned base, with no overlapping changes. Integration-tier projection.test.ts/projection.plain.test.ts and the final full/browser gate remain coordinator-owned as explicitly authorized.

review.summary: T753 satisfies its complete acceptance and the current complete CLUB-14/15/18, ECON-6, WEB-109 and ARCH-4/21/30/32 decisions at pinned base 972c570539e3340cb8d882f5b2749038bb3ca803. Reviewed exact submission 67d29a20a396550c290f8f872d23805454507ad8, its complete merge-base diff (RecruitmentDesk.tsx, its test and task result only), and current upstream policy interaction. A verified exact-world/revision detail can refresh only the still-active unsubmitted asking. The selected percentage remains unchanged; useMarketDetail keys the resulting exact fee so odds cannot be reused for the previous fee. Transaction amounts stay unavailable and submission stays blocked while requesting or reconciling a changed quote; bid-head money from another revision is hidden across a currency period transition. Current fee/detail/bidding refs also reject retained old handlers, while existing live-state guards continue to reject stale revisions or blocked actions. Same asking causes no refresh loop. Already-submitted bid commands/terms, engine prices/chances, canonical facts, retained inspection behavior and locale subscriptions remain unchanged. The existing shared Money boundary supplies current-era notation and exact disclosure only after the verified quote is coherent. Mounted synthetic tests use the actual detail hook and task memory and controlled promises; they cover increased/decreased same-revision asking, 130% retention, exact displayed/submitted fees, old fee/revision replies, retained handlers, pending state, currency transitions, unchanged asking and closing. Red evidence reproduces both original repricing failures; focused evidence passes 78 cases in 2 files. The exact submission receipt passes 5 affected files/71 cases plus typecheck/lint/format/i18n/build. Happy-dom is per-file only and roots/task memory/globals are cleaned after each test. No new source test runs were necessary; no browser/integration/full checks were run. The separate broader held-market/inspection snapshot observation is outside T753 and was not folded into this review. Upstream next remains the pinned base and its newer HIST/SAVE policy-only changes do not interact with this market source.
